sources.snippet: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Description A multimodal mixture-of-experts (MoE) model containing 35B total parameters (3B activated), 40 layers, and a context length of 262k tokens (extendable to 1.01M via YaRN), designed for agentic coding, multimodal reasoning, and long-context understanding across text, image, and video inputs.
